Re-check these netdisk-pan records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/quark-cloud-drive $.egress.terms: Page supports only 2-4 MB/s free vs about 50 MB/s SVIP. The 60 KB/s third-party measurement and the client user agent/cookie condition for downloads above 50 MB are not on this page; the page says free users are not cut to 100 KB/s.
- netdisk-pan/doubao-drive $.free_tier.unit: Page gives no free capacity figure, so no unit (TiB) is stated.
- netdisk-pan/baidu-pan $.per_object_cap.bytes: Web limit is 1G, but desktop client allows 4G for ordinary users, so 1e9 is not the free per-file cap. 1G is also not shown as decimal GB.
- netdisk-pan/115-cloud-drive-115 $.limits[1].value: Page names only an ID-card photo for individuals plus other materials the onboarding page prompts. 真实姓名, 证件类型, 证件号码 and 有效期 do not appear in the capture.
- netdisk-pan/62cloud-61cloud $.free_tier.stated: Page lists 61G for free users in an August 2026 promotion post. The quoted words 国内商家，注册送61g are not in the capture, and 注册送 (given on registration) is not stated. Fresh read the same.
- netdisk-pan/62cloud-61cloud $.free_tier.unit: Page says 61G; it does not state GiB vs GB.
- netdisk-pan/ctfile $.extras.registration: Form shows email, password, Turnstile security check. No 5-character verification code appears; the capture also offers phone sign-up.
- netdisk-pan/terabox $.identity_cost.detail: Blog says new accounts cannot register by phone. It does not list email registration fields (user name, date of birth, verification code) or absence of card/ID fields.
- netdisk-pan/62cloud-61cloud $.identity_cost.detail: Page covers email-domain list and no temporary email. No CNY 0.10 Alipay real-name payment or forum post on that in this capture.
- netdisk-pan/62cloud-61cloud $.notes: Direct-link move is supported, but the note says seasonal WebDAV; post/153 says WebDAV is available after buying membership. The note also claims forum-derived documentation and 61 GB, which this page does not cover. A claim is the field's whole value, and the auditor must find one span in your capture that says it. For every field named in a confirm's paths, the value must be exactly what that one quote proves. When a field's value is a synthesis of several facts, do one of these: capture a page that states all of it and quote that; or narrow the field's value to the fact your quote proves and move each other fact to its own field or limits row with its own evidence; or leave the field out of every confirm and list it in unread. Never name a field whose value goes beyond its quote.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/ctfile $.identity_cost.detail: Quote shows only the sign-up payload (email, password, captcha). The 5-character length, terms acceptance, phone alternative and the negatives (no card, ID, PRC phone) are not in this span.
- netdisk-pan/baidu-pan $.egress.terms: Span gives only the 0.1M/s table figure. 'Anything sizeable needs the desktop or mobile client' and 'metered by throttle rather than by byte' are not stated.
- netdisk-pan/ctfile $.extras.registration: Span proves the 5-character image code only. Turnstile, phone alternative and their pairing with the email form are in separate fragments of the bundle, not one span.
- netdisk-pan/115-cloud-drive-115 $.egress.terms: Span proves ordinary speed for free users and a priority channel for VIP. 'No per-GB fee' and 'share downloads require a login / could not be tested anonymously' are not in the source.
- netdisk-pan/aliyun-drive $.limits[2].value: Quote is a phone-number prompt; nothing says the open platform needs an Alibaba-reviewed application.
- netdisk-pan/quark-cloud-drive $.egress.terms: Table gives 2-4 MB/s vs about 50 MB/s; 'No per-GB fee is published' is an absence the span does not prove.
- netdisk-pan/aliyun-drive $.egress.terms: Table gives 0.5M/s; 'No per-GB charge' is not stated in the span.
- netdisk-pan/baidu-pan $.per_object_cap.bytes: Source states caps of 1G (web) and 4G (desktop client) for ordinary users, not that the cap is null; the value null is not shown.
- netdisk-pan/62cloud-61cloud $.identity_cost.country: Span says registration uses an email address; it says nothing on country eligibility, so a null country is not shown.
- netdisk-pan/ctfile $.per_object_cap.stated: Capture shows 20GB per file on the free sign-up page; '30 GB on Standard' does not appear in it.
- netdisk-pan/aliyun-drive $.tooling: Span only shows the words 开放平台. OAuth, app review, OpenList built-in key pair and no official rclone backend are not in this capture.
- netdisk-pan/115-cloud-drive-115 $.retention.stated: 原石用户 column (last) shows 15天, but not all paid tiers get 30天: 体验VIP and 尝鲜VIP columns also show 15天.
- netdisk-pan/doubao-drive $.egress.terms: Poster's own 5G test is stated; a 'later test agreeing' and the absence of a published egress term are not shown (a later reply only says 'I'll test first').
